title: Increase Natural Aim PvP Authority
objective: Make player-target aim assistance materially stronger during real PvP without turning normal mob/static behavior into hard lock.
acceptance_criteria: Committed player targets resist incidental opposite mouse corrections more than static/mob targets.
Committed PvP tracking keeps most correction strength during fast strafing/flick-like camera speeds.
Player aim point gains controlled torso-center bias and small motion lead.
Player-specific correction authority is stronger without changing mob correction behavior.
Manual sustained pull-away still releases the target.
Minecraft 26.2 Java 25 build, simulations, smoke launch, and JAR verification pass.
